title: Security Review Findings
summary: Security review findings and positive controls for Nuvei payment processor, browser enabler, webhooks, money-moving operations, and verification results.
notes: Manifest declared DOC. Document records security review findings, remediation guidance, positive controls, and verification results; it does not establish locked architectural decisions.
constraints: Treat unsigned DMN fields as untrusted and revalidate all transaction types against the Nuvei API before updating commercetools.
Persist processed webhook identifiers with TTL, reject stale responseTimeStamp values, and dedupe on immutable Nuvei event or transaction identifiers.
Enforce positive integer money amounts, validate currency format, and compare capture/refund amounts against authorized, captured, and refunded CT payment totals before calling Nuvei.
Require https: processor URLs, with any localhost HTTP exception limited to explicit development mode.
Validate merchant return URLs against an explicit origin allowlist before returning or using them.
Reuse existing pending cart payments or require idempotency keys, and add rate limiting for session-authenticated payment creation.
Add CI or build-time verification of the Nuvei SDK SRI hash and document the hash rotation procedure.
